paite: Huan TOUPA bawm Philistia mite gam ah kha sagih sung a-om hi.
heading: Thukhun Bawm Piakkikna

paite: Philistia mite'n, "TOUPA bawm bang i loh ding ua? A-omna ngei mah apaisak nawndan hon hilh dih ve ua," chi in asiampute leh aisan siamte asam uhi.

Amau, "Israelte' Pathian bawm na paisak ding uleh leng avuak in paisak het kei un. Akiang ah tatlek kithoihna lan ngeingei un. Huchi in hihdam in na om ding uh. Huchi in bangziak a akhut nou a pan lakkhiak a om lou ahia chih na thei ding uh," achi uhi.

Huchi in amau, "Akiang a ka tatlekna thillat ding bang ahia?" achi uh. Amau, "Philistia hausate zah dangka-eng zaangtan lim nga leh dangka-eng sansim lim nga; na vek ua tung leh na hausate uh tung a leng hipi lah khat ahi ngal a.

Huaiziak in na zaangtan lim uh leh na gam uh hihsetu sansim limte bawl un. Israelte' Pathian thupina pia un, huchi in akhut na tung uah, na pathiante uleh na gam uh tung ah azangsak nuam khamoh kei ding," achi uhi.
Aigupta mite leh Pharaoh in lungsim akhauhsak bang un bangziak a na lungtang uh khauhsak na hi ua? Alak ua thillamdang ahih in mite paisak in apawtkhesak uh, hilou maw?
Huaiziak in tu in kangtalai thak sutuah unla, bawngpi nih anawi suk lai, hakkol po ngei lou toh; huai bawngpite kangtalai ah khih unla, anoute uh amau a pan inn ah hon pi un.
TOUPA bawm la unla, kangtalai ah koih unla; tatlek thoihna dia na lat uh dangka-eng thil pen singlem ah thun in asik a koih in, paisak unla, khah un.

Huchi in gamgi lam pang lampi tawn in Beth-shemesh ah apai hiam en un, apaileh i tung ua thil hoih loutak amah hih ana hi dia; apai keileh ei hon gawtpa amah khut ana hi kei chih i thei ding ua, i tung ua hong om himhim lel ahi ding, achi uhi.
Mite'n huchibang in ahih ua; bawngpi anawi suk lai nih api ua, kangtalai ah akhih ua, anoute uh bel inn lam ah akhum uhi.
Sansim lim dangka-eng leh zaangtan lim koihna singlem toh kangtalai ah TOUPA bawm akoih uhi.

Bawngpite'n Beth-shemesh lam zuan in lampi azui vengveng ua; huchi in ham kawmkawm in lampi azui ua, taklam ah hiam, veilam ah hiam apial het kei uh. Philistia hausate'n Beth-shemesh gamgi pha in azui uhi.
Beth-shemesh khomite'n phaizang ah buh ana la ua, adaktou ua, bawm amu ua, akipahpih mahmah uhi.
Huai kangtalai Beth-shemesh a mi Joshua lou ah alut a, suangpi lian mahmah omna tak ah akhawita hi. Kangtalai sing a-ek ua, TOUPA kiang ah bawngpite halmang thillat in alan uhi.
Levi chite'n TOUPA bawm dangka-eng thil omna singlem toh alakhia ua, suangpi tung ah akoih uhi. Beth-shemesh khomite'n huai ni mah in halmang thillatte leh kithoihnate TOUPA kiang ah alan uhi.
Huai Philistia hausa ngate'n amuh nung un, huai ni mahmah in Ekron kholam ah apai nawnta uhi.

Philistia mite'n dangka-eng zaangtan lim TOUPA kiang a tatlek thoihna dia alat uh, Ashdod kho tuam a ding in khat, Gaza kho tuam a ding in khat, Ashkelon kho tuam a ding in khat, Gath kho tuam a ding in khat, Ekron kho tuam a ding in khat ahi.

Dangka-eng sansim lim ahihleh kho tengteng kulh nei khua leh singtang lam khua leng sim vek a hausa ngate a Philistia mite kho zah ahi. TOUPA bawm angakna suangpi mahmah uh Beth-shemesh khomi Joshua lou ah tuni tan in a-om nilouh lai hi.
TOUPA bawm sung a-et ziak un Beth-shemesh khomite ama'n agawt a, alak ua mi sangnga-le-sawmsagih tak athat hi. TOUPA'N anak thah ziak in mite'n asuun uhi.
Beth-shemesh khomite'n, hiai Pathian siangthou TOUPA ma ah kua adingh thei in ei a pan kua kiang ah ahia apaitouh ding? achi uh.
Huchi in Kiriath-jearim khomite kiang ah, "Philistia mite'n TOUPA bawm ahong koih nawn ua, hong suk unla na kiang uah latou dih ua," chi a hilh ding in thupo mite asawlta uhi.
